flags.message: All three predictions were created 2026-10-14 (16:02-18:22 UTC), the same date the application was denied as moot, yet each was provisioned a 2026-10-08 snapshot (cutoff 2026-10-09) whose context shows response_requested false, referred_to_court false, amicus 0 - although the docket shows a response request and an amicus brief on Oct 8, a response Oct 10 and a reply Oct 11 (documents fetched 2026-10-13). The response-requested moment was forecast from a stale baseline, and the denial may have been public before some predictions ran. No candidate's reasoning shows knowledge of the outcome (all predicted granted).

codex-baseline's retrieval_log.json captures only 4 'other' shell calls, while its retrieval.md discloses web searches and CourtListener search/search_document calls (Hollingsworth v. Perry) absent from the log. Possible transcript-capture gap for that engine/subagent pattern.

gemini-baseline ran a web search for '26A477 Supreme Court' on the resolution date with all results unobserved (coverage 0.0); retrieved_outcome_material left null. Its forecast (granted) is opposite the outcome, so no influence graded.
